title: Bryan Kohberger, Convicted in Idaho College Killings, Seeks to Take Back Guilty Plea
summary: In an interview from prison, Bryan Kohberger said he had filed a petition to reopen the case. He blamed his guilty plea on “false promises” and wrong information.
